environments.interpretation: Successful repository environment listing contains only github-pages. This supplies concrete absence-from-list evidence for release-certification beyond the earlier ambiguous specific-endpoint404. repository_permissions.interpretation: Observed repository permission booleans only; technical access is not user authorization to change settings or dispatch work.
